meta.description: kid-system knowledge-layer retrieval index (English mirror): maps parenting problem keywords (bilingual zh/en) to methodology files under knowledge/en/, per docs/DESIGN.md §6.3 safety filtering and §6.7 multilingual strategy. Skills match keywords first, then read the resource's section. Age-based data (sleep/feeding/milestones) remains in references/knowledge-index.json. level meanings: general=general navigation and overviews; method=classic parenting methodologies (books/communication techniques); scenario=immediate responses for concrete situations (problem navigation / rescue games).
meta.usage: keywords support mixed Chinese/English matching so both languages hit; resource is a repository-relative path under knowledge/ (this mirror points to knowledge/en/ files); section names a section or topic block inside the file. The zh primary source is knowledge/index.json.

entries.section: Triage principles (rule out physiological causes → check age-appropriateness → apply strategies)
Emotions & Behavior → Tantrums (L1 in-the-moment + L2 emotion vocabulary and trigger logging)
Emotions & Behavior → Hitting/Biting (immediate stop + substitute actions)
Emotions & Behavior → Grabbing/Not sharing (timed turns + ownership language)
Emotions & Behavior → Lying (no trap questions + real-or-made-up games)
Emotions & Behavior → Dawdling (concrete first-step instructions + visual routines)
Emotions & Behavior → Separation anxiety (fixed goodbye ritual + graded practice)
Emotions & Behavior → Night terrors & nightmares (don't wake terrors / comfort and rewrite nightmares)
Emotions & Behavior → Screen-time battles (preview + countdown + screen-free substitutes)
Feeding & Nutrition → Picky eating (15-exposure rule + same-category swaps)
Feeding & Nutrition → Playing during meals (leaving the table ends the meal + meal structure)
Feeding & Nutrition → Appetite fluctuations (judge intake by the week, not the meal)
Feeding & Nutrition → Snack demands (snack schedule + visibility management)
Feeding & Nutrition → Self-feeding regression (lower the difficulty ladder + extra connection)
Sleep & Rhythm → Frequent night waking (delayed response + bedtime routine and night-feed weaning)
Sleep & Rhythm → Sleep regressions / nap refusal (quiet-time floor + spotting nap transitions)
Sleep & Rhythm → Bedtime stalling / early waking (pre-packed needs + blackout and low interaction)
Social Skills & Habits → Potty training (readiness check + visualized routine)
Social Skills & Habits → Sibling rivalry (exclusive big-kid time + big-kid privileges)
Social Skills & Habits → Preschool adjustment (short goodbyes + advance preview)
Social Skills & Habits → Fears (validate the fear + role-play desensitization)
Playful Parenting (connection through play; dissolving standoffs and fears)
Positive Discipline (limit enforcement without punishment or permissiveness)
Nonviolent Communication (observation-feeling-need-request, applied to parenting)
P.E.T. Parent Effectiveness Training (problem ownership + no-lose conflict resolution)
The Whole-Brain Child (integrating the brain; naming emotions to tame them)

entries.section: How to Talk So Kids Will Listen (empathic responses; concrete alternatives to praise and criticism)
Reflective listening + I-messages (copy-ready daily dialogue scripts)
By age → 0-1 years (visual stimulation and interactive reading)
By age → 1-3 years (daily-life habits and early emotion recognition)
By age → 3-6 years + themed lists (emotions / separation / potty / sleep entry points)
Rescue games for cooking time (self-directed play needing no continuous parent involvement)
Car-ride games (no props; voice and observation games)
Queue / waiting games (quiet, playable in tiny spaces)
Bedtime calming games (low-arousal closing games)
